import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import re
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from sklearn.calibration import CalibratedClassifierCV
import lightgbm as lgb
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Load data from the correct input directory
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")


# Enhanced text preprocessing with insult-focused cleaning
def clean_text(text):
    if pd.isna(text):
        return ""
    # Remove surrounding quotes and decode unicode escapes
    text = text.strip('"')
    # Convert escape sequences
    text = text.replace("\\n", " ").replace("\\t", " ").replace("\\r", " ")
    # Remove HTML tags
    text = re.sub(r"<.*?>", " ", text)
    # Handle common insult-related patterns
    text = re.sub(r"\\u[a-fA-F0-9]{4}", " ", text)  # unicode escapes
    # Keep apostrophes and basic punctuation but normalize whitespace
    text = re.sub(r"[^a-zA-Z0-9\s!?,.\'\"-]", " ", text)
    # Normalize whitespace
    text = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text).strip()
    return text.lower()


# Clean text
train_df["clean_comment"] = train_df["Comment"].apply(clean_text)
test_df["clean_comment"] = test_df["Comment"].apply(clean_text)


# Extract date features
def extract_date_features(date_str):
    if pd.isna(date_str) or date_str == "":
        return [0] * 6
    try:
        year = int(date_str[:4])
        month = int(date_str[4:6])
        day = int(date_str[6:8])
        hour = int(date_str[8:10])
        minute = int(date_str[10:12])
        second = int(date_str[12:14])
        return [year, month, day, hour, minute, second]
    except:
        return [0] * 6


# Apply date feature extraction
train_date_features = np.array([extract_date_features(d) for d in train_df["Date"]])
test_date_features = np.array([extract_date_features(d) for d in test_df["Date"]])

# TF-IDF with word and character n-grams
# Word-level features
tfidf_word = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=8000, ngram_range=(1, 2), min_df=2, max_df=0.95, sublinear_tf=True
)
X_train_word = tfidf_word.fit_transform(train_df["clean_comment"])
X_test_word = tfidf_word.transform(test_df["clean_comment"])

# Character-level n-grams to capture slang and abbreviations
tfidf_char = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="char",
    ngram_range=(3, 5),
    max_features=5000,
    min_df=2,
    max_df=0.95,
    sublinear_tf=True,
)
X_train_char = tfidf_char.fit_transform(train_df["clean_comment"])
X_test_char = tfidf_char.transform(test_df["clean_comment"])

# Combine TF-IDF features
X_train_tfidf = np.hstack([X_train_word.toarray(), X_train_char.toarray()])
X_test_tfidf = np.hstack([X_test_word.toarray(), X_test_char.toarray()])

# Combine with date features
X_train = np.hstack([X_train_tfidf, train_date_features])
X_test = np.hstack([X_test_tfidf, test_date_features])

# Target variable
y_train = train_df["Insult"].values

# Split for validation (hold-out set for calibration and final evaluation)
X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
)

# LightGBM base model parameters
params = {
    "objective": "binary",
    "metric": "auc",
    "boosting_type": "gbdt",
    "num_leaves": 63,
    "learning_rate": 0.03,
    "feature_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_freq": 5,
    "seed": 42,
    "min_child_samples": 20,
    "reg_alpha": 0.1,
    "reg_lambda": 0.1,
}

# Create calibrated classifier with Platt scaling (sigmoid) using 5-fold CV
base_model = lgb.LGBMClassifier(**params, n_estimators=2000, verbose=-1)
calibrated_model = CalibratedClassifierCV(base_model, method="sigmoid", cv=5)

# Fit on training data (use full training set for calibration)
calibrated_model.fit(X_tr, y_tr)

# Validate on hold-out set
val_preds = calibrated_model.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]
auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_preds)
print(f"Validation AUC: {auc:.5f}")

# Predict on test set using calibrated model
test_preds = calibrated_model.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]

# Create submission with proper formatting
# Generate sequential IDs starting from 1 since no explicit ID column exists
submission = pd.DataFrame({"Id": range(1, len(test_preds) + 1), "Insult": test_preds})
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
